notes:
— Quick summary: Mid-market SaaS vendor (product analytics + end-user help) evaluating Redwood Hosted -> Dedicated. Primary driver: deterministic latency and auditability for enterprise customers; also data residency for EU tenant data. Currently running POC on Hosted API; moving to Dedicated for SLA and VPC isolation if security review clears.

— Commercial / GTM notes: Intro call 2025-11-18 (Maya). Free credits used to validate embedding quality. Pricing sensitivity: medium-high; wants unit economics before committing to reserved capacity. Draft pricing shared 2026-02-14; need final SOW and commitment window to lock rates. ARR target if successful: $60k-$150k ARR first year.

— Technical requirements / goals: workload mix = embeddings-heavy search + chat-based support assistant. Target SLOs: 95th perc latency <150ms for chat generate calls; sustained throughput target ~50 req/s with spikes to 120 req/s. Model preference: open models (Llama/Redwood-verified) with fallback to quantized variants. Require canary rollouts, model pinning, and automatic fallback routing across tiers. Must support prefix/KV caching and per-route batching.

— Security & compliance conversation (primary focus): Elm Mosaic has enterprise customers who require SOC2 Type II, SSO via SAML (Okta), long-term audit logs and e-discovery capabilities. Security questionnaire submitted 2026-02-24 (see Drive doc). Requests from their InfoSec:
  • SOC2 report copy and attestation timeline (they asked whether Redwood has SOC2 Type II and scope for Hosted vs Dedicated).
  • SAML/SSO integration details + metadata for Okta IdP; want test IdP before Dedicated onboarding.
  • Audit logs: retention controls and export (they currently need evidence they can retain logs for up to 7 years for regulated customers).
  • Data residency: support for EU-segmented tenants and ability to keep inference artifacts within region.
  • KMS/HSM: customer-managed keys preferred for encryption at rest of model artifacts and logs.
  • Right-to-be-forgotten / selective purge for PII in call logs.

— Timeline & activities (bullets):
  • 2025-11-18: discovery intro (Maya) — quick product fit, ask for cost estimator.
  • 2025-12-05: sandbox testing using Hosted API embeddings — positive quality signal.
  • 2026-01-22: Hosted API demo (product flows + embeddings) — SE deep-dive, show streaming and function-calling.
  • 2026-02-11: Dedicated demo + capacity discussion (Arjun) — showed VPC peering architecture and autoscale options.
  • 2026-02-14: pricing deck shared (Drive link) — initial committed-capacity scenarios; follow-up ask on model quantization tiers.
  • 2026-02-24: security questionnaire submitted (customer) — InfoSec follow-up scheduled.
  • 2026-03-02: security deep-dive with InfoSec (fireflies ff-20260302-security-deepdive) — clarified SAML flow, audit log access patterns, retention controls.
  • 2026-03-09: performance POC results shared (hosted) — embeddings latency 95p ~85ms, chat median 80ms; cost per 1k tokens higher on hosted but acceptable for POC.

— POC acceptance criteria:
  1) Meet latency SLOs on Dedicated in their staging (95p <150ms) under 50 req/s sustained.
  2) Demonstrate SAML SSO integration with test Okta tenant.
  3) Provide SOC2 Type II evidence or roadmap with timeline.
  4) Show audit logging with configurable retention + export to their SIEM.

— Pricing / procurement notes: Commercial prefers 12-month reserved Dedicated with 30% discount for 12-month commit; wants optional burst credits. Still negotiating final commit size. CFO will sign once security deliverables are confirmed.
